name: Anjani Kumar Pandey
intro: I'm a software engineer at Celigo, where I work on integrator.io - building the backend services that move data between business systems: files, databases, data warehouses, and APIs.
about: Most of my work is in Node.js microservices: adaptor services that speak FTP, S3, MySQL, Oracle, and MongoDB on one side, and the integrator.io platform on the other. That includes the on-premise agent bridge that connects the cloud platform to customer data centers over WebSockets.
Recently I've been working on the platform's API layer and its Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, which lets AI coding assistants build integrations directly.
I also maintain end-to-end API test automation that exercises the live platform - contract validation, flow execution, and data-landing verification.

projects.title: Adaptor microservices
projects.description: Backend services that move data between integrator.io and external systems - file servers (FTP, SFTP, S3), relational databases (MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle), NoSQL stores, and data warehouses.

projects.title: Endpoint service & MCP integration
projects.description: The API layer of the integrator.io platform, including the Model Context Protocol integration that lets AI coding assistants build integrations programmatically.

projects.title: On-premise agent bridge
projects.description: Connectivity between the cloud platform and agents running in customer data centers, over authenticated WebSocket channels.

projects.title: API test automation
projects.description: End-to-end test suites that run against the live integrator.io APIs - contract validation, backward compatibility, flow execution, and data-landing verification.

projects.title: AI tooling for integrations
projects.description: Domain knowledge and tools for building Celigo integrations with AI coding assistants.
